summary.text: James Rutledge is the Republican nominee for Attorney General of Maryland. A Harford County attorney of about four decades, he served as a Bel Air town commissioner from November 2023 to October 2025 and is campaigning on crime, support for law enforcement and keeping the office from suing the federal government over policy disagreements.

paragraphs.text: Graduate of the University of Maryland School of Law, licensed to practice in Maryland and Georgia, with more than 30 years of practice.
Elected a Bel Air town commissioner in November 2023 and served until October 2025.

sources.title: Rutledge faces steep climb to unseat Brown in low-key attorney general's race
